title: 品格教育：感恩
footer: Teacher Dom · Character Education: Gratitude 品格教育：感恩

slides.eyebrow_zh: 跟 Dom 老師上品格教育

strip.en: years old this year — your school
strip.zh: 歲——你們學校今年的年紀

strip.en: from a neighbor for your bilingual classroom
strip.zh: 鄰居捐給你們數位雙語教室的金額

strip.en: thank-you card from each of you

lines.en: I have been teaching students in Taiwan for a couple of years.
lines.zh: 我在台灣教學生已經有幾年了。

slides.ask_en: Since you woke up today, who did something for you?
slides.ask_zh: 從今天起床到現在，有誰為你做了什麼？

slides.ask_en: I flew 13 hours to get here. Many people helped me on the way. Can you guess who?
slides.ask_zh: 我飛了 13 個小時才到這裡，一路上有很多人幫我。猜猜看是誰？

slides.body_en: Gratitude means noticing what other people do for you — and then saying thank you, or giving something back.
slides.body_zh: 感恩，就是注意到別人為你做了什麼——然後說聲謝謝，或是回饋一點什麼。

prompts.en: Stand up if someone made breakfast for you today.
prompts.zh: 今天有人幫你準備早餐的，站起來。

prompts.en: Stand up if someone brought you to school today.
prompts.zh: 今天有人送你來學校的，站起來。

prompts.en: Stand up if you said thank you to them.
prompts.zh: 有跟他們說謝謝的，站起來。

slides.punch_en: So many people help us every day. We just don't always notice.
slides.punch_zh: 每天有好多人在幫我們，只是我們不一定注意到。

slides.q_en: Riddle: I start work before you wake up. I cook lunch for the whole school. Who am I?
slides.q_zh: 猜猜我是誰：你還沒起床我就開始工作，我為全校煮午餐。
slides.explain_en: A school cook! At Lushang, your lunch is cooked right behind the Huai-en Pavilion. Next time, think about whose hands made it.
slides.explain_zh: 午餐廚工！在路上，你們的午餐就在懷恩亭後面煮好。下次吃午餐時，想想是誰的手做出來的。

slides.ask_en: Huai-en means “remember kindness.” Every day, you walk past a reminder to say thank you.
slides.ask_zh: 「懷恩」就是把別人的恩情放在心上。你們每天經過它，它都在提醒你說謝謝。

slides.q_en: This summer, Lushang students spent 7 days in Japan and studied in a Japanese school. Who made the trip possible?
slides.q_zh: 今年暑假，路上的同學到日本 7 天，還進了日本的小學上課。是誰讓這趟旅程成真？
slides.explain_en: A Lushang alumnus, Chairman Hsieh Wen-hsiang! Long ago he sat in your seats. Now he gives back so you can see the world.
slides.explain_zh: 是路上的校友謝文祥董事長！很久以前他就坐在你們的位子上，現在回饋母校，讓你們看見世界。

slides.body_en: Your digital bilingual classroom, with AR, robots and talking pens, was built with NT$570,000 from Mr. Xie Shih-ying of the Lushang Daitianfu temple. Mr. Hsu Li-wei gave your school a piano. Your whole village is cheering for you.
slides.body_zh: 你們的數位雙語教室——有 AR、機器人和點讀筆——是路上代天府主委謝世英先生捐 57 萬元蓋的。許立葦董事長還送給學校一架鋼琴。整個村子都在為你們加油。

slides.q_en: Since 2017, every Lushang student has had their own… what?
slides.q_zh: 從 2017 年起，路上的每一個學生都有一個自己的……什麼？
slides.explain_en: An ocarina! Your school made sure every child could make music — a gift you can hold in your hands.
slides.explain_zh: 陶笛！學校讓每個孩子都能吹出音樂——一份可以握在手裡的禮物。

slides.head_zh: 真的還假的？手比 ⭕ 或 ❌

items.en: You only need to say thank you for big things.
items.zh: 只有大事才需要說謝謝。
items.note_en: Small things count too — like holding a door.
items.note_zh: 小事也算——像是幫你扶門。

items.en: Saying thank you can make YOU happier, too.
items.zh: 說謝謝也會讓自己更快樂。
items.note_en: Scientists have studied it: grateful people often feel happier.
items.note_zh: 科學家研究過：懂得感恩的人通常比較快樂。

items.note_en: Your alumni and neighbors showed it with actions. So can you.
items.note_zh: 你們的校友和鄰居用行動表現。你也可以。

items.en: Saying thank you takes a lot of time.
items.note_zh: 五秒鐘就夠了。今天就試試看！

items.zh: 我真的很感謝你的幫忙。

items.en: We couldn't do it without you.

slides.rule_en: In 30 seconds, shout out as many helpers as you can — in English. I will count!
slides.rule_zh: 30 秒內，用英文喊出越多「幫助我們的人」越好，我來數！

slides.prompt_en: Who is one person at Lushang you want to thank?
slides.prompt_zh: 在路上國小，你最想感謝的一個人是誰？
slides.time_en: One minute each. Then I will ask two of you.
slides.time_zh: 每人一分鐘。然後我會請兩位分享。

slides.tip_en: Give it to them yourself — today!

slides.note_en: Watch — then tell me: who will get YOUR card?
slides.note_zh: 看完之後，告訴我：你的卡片要送給誰？

slides.head_zh: 今天就可以做的 3 件事

items.en: Say thank you to a helper — and use their name.
items.zh: 向一位幫助你的人說謝謝——叫出他的名字。

items.en: Give your card to the person you wrote it for.
items.zh: 把卡片親手交給你寫給的那個人。

items.en: Help a younger student. One day, YOU will be the alumni who gives back.
items.zh: 幫學弟妹一個忙。有一天，你也會是回饋母校的校友。

slides.q_en: Dom's neighbors in California say “gracias” every day. Which language is it?
slides.q_zh: Dom 在加州的鄰居每天都說「gracias」。那是哪一種語言？
slides.explain_en: Spanish! Merci is French, danke is German, and arigatō is Japanese.
slides.explain_zh: 西班牙文！Merci 是法文，danke 是德文，arigatō 是日文。

slides.body_en: Go to our School Tour page and find the Lushang Elementary column. No sign-up, no login — tell Dom who you thanked today.
slides.body_zh: 到我們網站的 School Tour 頁面，找到路上國小那一欄，免註冊、免登入，告訴 Dom 你今天感謝了誰。

slides.big_zh: 把恩情放在心上，再把它傳下去。
